description: Every Logitech manual, spec sheet, and install guide — searchable offline, agent-native, no browser.

tools.name: articles_by_section
tools.description: List articles in one section (server-side scoped). Required: section_id. Optional: page-size (default: 100), cursor. Returns array of ArticleSummary.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: articles_get
tools.description: Get a single article including its HTML body. Required: article_id. Returns the Article.

tools.name: articles_list
tools.description: List articles (filter by label). Optional: label_names, page-size (default: 100), cursor. Returns array of ArticleSummary.

params.name: label_names
params.description: Filter by label, e.g. webcontent=productspecs or webcontent=productdocument

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: articles_search
tools.description: Search articles by text. Required: query. Optional: label_names, per_page (default: 25), page (default: 1). Returns array of ArticleSummary.

params.name: label_names
params.description: Filter results by label, e.g. webcontent=productspecs

tools.name: categories_list
tools.description: List the top-level Logitech support categories (Mice and Pointers, Keyboards, Webcams, Gaming, Video Collaboration, and so on). Takes no parameters. Returns an array of Category objects with id, name, description, html_url, and position. Call this first when you need a category id to narrow sections_list; prefer articles_search or the docs command when you already know the product name or keyword.

tools.name: sections_list
tools.description: List sections (optionally filtered by category). Optional: category_id, per_page (default: 100), page (default: 1). Returns array of Section.

novel_features.name: Friendly doc-type search
novel_features.description: Search Logitech support docs by friendly type: spec sheet, manual, install guide, FAQ, download, warranty.

novel_features.name: Offline full-text search
novel_features.description: Full-text search inside synced manuals and spec sheets from the local store.

novel_features.name: Download resolver
novel_features.description: Resolve download01.logi.com file links in an article and fetch them (with --dry-run and local cache).

novel_features.name: Spec comparison
novel_features.description: Side-by-side spec comparison between two products from synced spec sheets.
